description:
## Why

PKIX-amgn.8.3 ships the transform tool. This bead runs it once against current zlint master, commits the output, and lands the crate-root NOTICE file.

## What

1. Refresh checkouts:
   ```
   git -C ~/GIT/zlint pull --depth=1 origin master
   ZLINT_SHA=$(git -C ~/GIT/zlint rev-parse --short HEAD)
   ```
2. Generate catalog:
   ```
   zlint -listLintsJSON > /tmp/zlint-lints.json
   cargo run -p pkix-lint-cabf-refresh -- \\
     --zlint-output /tmp/zlint-lints.json \\
     --zlint-sha "$ZLINT_SHA" \\
     --output-dir pkix-lint-cabf/catalogs/
   ```
3. Commit `pkix-lint-cabf/catalogs/cabf-br-tls-derived-from-zlint-<sha7>.oscal.json`.
4. Write `pkix-lint-cabf/NOTICE` at crate root:
   - Full Apache-2.0 license text (or pointer + URL)
   - Per-vendored-asset section listing: filename, upstream URL, upstream SHA, license, copyright holder
   - Initial entry: cabf-br-tls catalog, github.com/zmap/zlint, <sha>, Apache-2.0, zmap contributors
5. Schema validation: if the tool didn't validate at generation time, validate now via oscal-cli (download/install if needed) and document outcome.
6. Update pkix-lint-cabf README to note the vendored catalogs and refresh workflow.

## Acceptance

- [ ] pkix-lint-cabf/catalogs/cabf-br-tls-derived-from-zlint-<sha7>.oscal.json committed.
- [ ] pkix-lint-cabf/NOTICE exists with full attribution.
- [ ] pkix-lint-cabf README documents the refresh workflow (one paragraph + code snippet).
- [ ] OSCAL Catalog schema validation passes (or schema-validation gap bd filed and linked).

## Out of scope

- cabf-br-smime, cabf-br-cs catalogs (future bds; same pattern).
- Runtime parser in pkix-lint-cabf (PKIX-amgn.8.5).
- First Rust Lint pairing example (PKIX-amgn.8.6).

## Depends on

PKIX-amgn.8.3.

## Filed by

Decomposed from PKIX-amgn.8 per Mark's 2026-05-11 decisions.
notes: Frozen 2026-05-12 (PKIX-ncab.2 cascade): parent PKIX-amgn.8 re-scoped because OSCAL is no longer prescribed as the catalog format. This issue is a snapshot of the OSCAL-target version of the work; it will be reworked, closed, or replaced when the replacement policy/config format is decided. Until then, do not claim autonomously.
title: Vendor first cabf-br-tls catalog: run refresh tool, commit output, write NOTICE
